Ava (CFO): Follow-up from today's all-hands on runway & procurement. Drop short Qs here.

Maya (eng): Is the runway number the one on the dashboard or adjusted for hires?

Ava (CFO): Dashboard shows 'months at projected burn' — includes accepted offers (with start dates) and committed vendor contracts once PO is issued. We smooth with a 3-month trailing average.

olivia (procurement): Quick ops note: fast-track vendor onboarding for infra partners = target 7 business days if vendor provides SOC2 + standard MSA. Use Jira 'Vendor Onboarding' and add label 'fast-track'.

Ravi (Finance Ops): P-card limits unchanged (eng $2k, mgr $10k). Any one-off >$50k needs Finance+Legal pre-approval. AP runs Tue/Thu.

Maya (eng): If a vendor needs a large setup fee before PO, can we proceed?

Ava (CFO): For customer-impacting work, open an 'Emergency Spend' ticket and tag @Ava and @Ravi — we can fast-approve case-by-case. Otherwise pause until PO.

Sofia (People): Reminder: People must be included on any headcount-linked contracts for ramp forecasting.

Ava (CFO): If blocked, reply with vendor + Jira ID and we'll triage. Thanks.
